note: What the built pack lets a player reach. A product with "enabled": false keeps its code in src/, its data in packs/ and every one of its tests and scenarios — only the files listed here are left out of dist/andrew.mcaddon, so the servers do not offer it. Turning it on is one word in this file. docs/dev/rollout.md.

underwater_bow.note: Legendary #8, spec v3 §1. Listed with its recipe only: the item, the token and the texture ship either way, so that a stack already in a chest never meets a pack that has forgotten its id.

vanilla_mace_recipe.note: spec v3 §2: the Mace out of an iron block and a breeze rod. Pure data — the result is a vanilla item and no script runs, so withholding the recipe withholds the whole product.

vanilla_rocket_recipe.note: spec v3 §3: rockets out of paper and string. The recipe is not the whole product — registerRocketFlight rewrites EVERY firework rocket that carries no data, whatever made it, so the registration goes too.

pearl_rod.note: spec v3 §6-§8, the Pearl Rod. The recipe is its only door: there is no give command, and the craft token is menu_category none, so Creative does not show it either. Its five registrations go too — registerPearlTeleport holds a reserved ticking-area slot out of the world's budget (L0-adr-prta), which returns to the structures pool while the product is off.
